DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 5 games · First game 6:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 8:21 PM ET

These are the NBA DFS projections for Sunday, November 15: the SPAGS model projection for every player on the DraftKings main slate (5 games), by position, from the November 15, 8:21 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model built by Chris Spags. Jalen Johnson (ATL) has the highest projection at 51.1 DraftKings points for $9,600.

Where can I find free NBA DFS projections?

On this page: every position on the DraftKings NBA main slate with SPAGS projection, salary and points per $1,000, updated with each run of the model. FanDuel projections, floors, ceilings, simulated win rates and exports are in the Splash Play NBA tool.

Who has the highest NBA DFS projection on the Nov 15 slate?

Jalen Johnson (ATL, PF) has the highest SPAGS model projection on the Sunday, November 15 DraftKings main slate at 51.1 points for $9,600, as of November 15, 8:21 PM ET.

When do these NBA DFS projections update?

Each time the slate's numbers are published. The time at the top of the page is the run shown.

Where can I get DraftKings NBA DFS projections and simulations?

Splash Play, built by Chris Spags, offers DraftKings NBA DFS projections, exports and simulation results. These pages show free SPAGS projections for the DraftKings main slate. Squirt Squad covers matchup research and the Projection Matrix. VIP adds SPAGS projections, exports and simulation results. Simulations are modeled outcomes, not guaranteed results.
